catches: Coins expire after 3 months of inactivity on the account — stay active or lose the balance (official help).
Per-receipt coin payouts are small; reaching the 1,000-coin ($5) minimum takes many receipts, and the amounts climb slowly after that (2,900=$15, 4,300=$25, 6,500=$40).

Payout timing: reward requests go through a review/approval step; official guidance cites approval within seven days (the located official cash-out page is the German one — US equivalent not separately found, flagged honestly).
Rewards are PayPal cash, Amazon gift cards, or Visa — Visa prepaid is included, but note prepaid-card terms.
Receipt Hog uses your receipt data for market research; the privacy/data trade-off is inherent to the app.

steps: Download the free Receipt Hog app from the App Store or Google Play.
Earn coins by snapping photos of your receipts after shopping; earn extra coins via surveys, slots, and sweepstakes entries.
Reach at least 1,000 coins ($5) — higher tiers: 2,900=$15, 4,300=$25, 6,500=$40.
Cash out in-app for PayPal cash, an Amazon gift card, or a Visa reward card.
Wait for review/approval (official: within seven days), then receive your payout.
Stay active — coins expire after 3 months of account inactivity.
